measurement.definition: Host monotonic time from last input PCM sample with abs(sample)>=64 to receipt of the first output PCM chunk containing abs(sample)>=64. Derived as waveform-EOF-to-first-output-signal plus measured trailing input quiet.
measurement.endpointing: 800 ms of wall time simulated AFTER input WAV EOF, plus real trailing digital quiet in the WAV. Conservative host simulation; does not execute or change the approved Android VAD. No fake PCM padding is sent.
measurement.clockDomains: Host perf_counter durations and server Stopwatch profiles are independent local monotonic clocks. Never subtract timestamps across these domains. Server profile elapsed times restart separately for stt/chat.
measurement.responseBoundary: The real authorized reply, including natural style, counts; activation sound and artificial waiting phrases do not. Wrong responses are retained and never count as correct performance.
physicalLimits: No physical Android VAD, speaker, route, volume or acoustic latency measured.
Input was synthetic eSpeak or Qwen speech, not phone microphone capture.
Real-time connection setup precedes paced WAV replay in this harness; native wake/pre-roll connection overlap is not simulated.
PCM bytes are downloaded; HTTP EOF and downloaded PCM duration do not prove playback completion.
Segment HTTP fetches use one worker; this does not simulate Android native prefetch/reproduction.
measurement.doneEventTiming: Recorded generationDoneMs is done-event RECEPTION for segmented runs or whole-reply HTTP reception for batch runs, not provider model completion. The original segmented reader could wait for a TTS future with two pending units, delaying done reception for responses with more than two units. Exported as doneReceivedMs/replyReceivedMs with a backpressure flag. Provider completion is available only in independent server_chat profile marks; no host/server clocks are subtracted.
measurement.segmentRequestTimestamps: Measurements preceded harness fix 45988f2. Legacy requestAtMs values are QUEUED timestamps, not actual HTTP starts for subsequent units. Exported as queuedAtMs; first-unit dispatch is explicitly only an approximation.
measurement.samplePolicy: All 60 recorded attempts are exported, including 11 HTTP failures, incorrect responses and outliers. The readiness pilot and renewed matrix are not substitutions for discarded measurements.
measurement.corpusPolicy: No corpus utterances, transcripts, response text, personal facts, audio, provider keys, identities, private paths or raw turn/request IDs are exported. Public IDs are phase-case pseudonyms. WAV hashes establish identical input reuse without publishing audio.
measurement.cacheLimits: The same four input cases repeat across ablation stages; their timings alone do not establish novel-request success. The final five held-out cases are separate. Provider system/input cache hits were observed and partial token usage is disclosed.
measurement.statisticPolicy: Descriptive summaries only for small per-stage samples; all raw values, min/max, mean/median, threshold counts and quality denominators are retained. Versions are not pooled for performance inference.

comparisonGroups.limitation: First five stages repeat four cases; final combined stage uses five previously held-out cases, so final corpus is not a paired per-question comparison.
Initial baseline/low used a different TTS source from demand/realtime/incremental. Cross-version change is not attributable solely to application code.

cost.deduplication: provider responseId across audits/assistant metadata; first two fresh followup log rounds added only after verifying final log round equals final metadata
cost.costScopeNote: These pipeline audio durations omit separate direct probes, quality-only tests and production smoke; no complete bill is inferred.
cost.speechAndTranscriptionCostCoverage: Per-phase captured input duration and output PCM bytes are available per sample; no provider billing receipt or complete monetary charge is exposed. Missing usage and auxiliary extraction/embedding/TTS costs prevent a total cost claim.

productionSmoke.timingReference: waveform EOF; host simulation; no physical playback

memoryQuality.measurementBoundary: text request through authorized final generation; no STT, TTS or speaker timing
